ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal intensity distribution with high contrast between black (low-intensity) and white (high-intensity) regions. Left lobe is approximately 65% white; right lobe is approximately 85% black.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous white region from the midline to the tip with dark circular mottling. Right lobe is predominantly solid black with a distinct high-contrast white triangular patch at the distal tip containing several dark ring-shaped spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with variable frequency along both trailing edges; higher amplitude peaks visible on the upper third of both lobes before merging into epibiont clusters at the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing margins with an upward sweep originating from the water surface line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular 'doughnut' shaped scars visible; concentrated cluster of 4-6 high-contrast rings on the white tip of the right lobe and several scattered across the white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical gray-scale linear marks visible within the black pigmentation of the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of barnacles (epibionts) at the distal tips of both lobes, creating significant volumetric and textural irregularities that alter the natural geometric boundary of the fluke tips.
